subject: english
question:
In the following question, the first and the last parts of the sentence/passage are numbered 1 and 6. The rest of the sentence/passage is split into four parts-P, Q, R, and S. These four parts are not given in their proper order. Read the sentence/passage and find the most logical order of the parts between 1 and 6.

Mathematics is essential in daily life.

P: Calculating discounts helps in shopping.

Q: Managing time also involves math skills.

R: From money to measurements, it is everywhere.

S: Even cooking depends on ratios and quantities.

6. So, learning math has practical value.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The first sentence introduces the importance of mathematics in daily life: **"Mathematics is essential in daily life."**
 
• **R comes first** as it explains the broad applicability of mathematics in daily activities: 
 
 
• "From money to measurements, it is everywhere."
 
 
 
• **P follows** as it provides a specific example of using math while shopping: 
 
 
• "Calculating discounts helps in shopping."
 
 
 
• **Q comes next** as it discusses another important aspect of math in managing time: 
 
 
• "Managing time also involves math skills."
 
 
 
• **S follows** as it highlights the use of mathematics in cooking: 
 
 
• "Even cooking depends on ratios and quantities."
 
 
 
• The concluding sentence ties the paragraph together, emphasizing the practical value of learning math: **"So, learning math has practical value."**
 
• The correct sequence is **RPQS**.

 

**Coherent paragraph after rearrangement**:

"Mathematics is essential in daily life. From money to measurements, it is everywhere. Calculating discounts helps in shopping. Managing time also involves math skills. Even cooking depends on ratios and quantities. So, learning math has practical value."
